name: i Power Solutions India Limited
about: i Power Solutions India Limited engages in the provision of e-business and internet Solutions in India and internationally. The company offers application and software development project services; website design and development; mean stack and full stack development, as well as data science and machine learning software development project services for US clients. It also provides telecom and networking, application development, infrastructure services, animation and multimedia, and technology strategy development services; e-commerce solutions, domain registration and webhosting, and enterprise resource planning services. In addition, the company offers training on software and hardware, bioinformatics and other IT training courses based on job opportunities; and operates vanavil.com, a social networking portal. i Power Solutions India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
